sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The TopKinematics class, implemented in Cython, is a specialized selection template within the AnalysisG framework, designed for comprehensive analysis of top quark kinematics in Monte Carlo 16 (MC16) events. It inherits from the generic SelectionTemplate class, extending its functionalities to extract and organize detailed information about resonant and spectator top quark kinematics (energy, eta, phi, pT), as well as mass and Delta-R (dR) combinations. This class facilitates a high-performance extraction and structuring of top quark kinematic data for further physics analysis.

sect1.title: Helper Functions (Python-style, Cython-optimized)
sect1.para: These functions are designed to be used as callbacks for self.root_leaves in SelectionTemplate, processing data as it's read from ROOT files.

listitem.para:
def res_data(zp, data): Processes kinematic data for "resonant" top quarks. It extracts the kinematic variable (energy, eta, phi, or pT) from data[1] and appends it to the corresponding list in zp.res_top_kinematics.
zp
An instance of TopKinematics.
data
A tuple (name_string, list_of_floats) where name_string indicates the kinematic variable and list_of_floats contains the values.

def spec_data(zp, data): Processes kinematic data for "spectator" top quarks. Similar to res_data, but appends to zp.spec_top_kinematics.
zp
An instance of TopKinematics.
data
A tuple (name_string, list_of_floats) containing the data.

def mass_data(zp, data): Processes mass combination data (e.g., "RR", "RS", "SS" for resonant-resonant, resonant-spectator, spectator-spectator combinations). It extracts the mass values from data[1] and appends them to the corresponding list in zp.mass_combi.
zp
An instance of TopKinematics.
data
A tuple (name_string, list_of_floats) containing the data.

def dr_data(zp, data): Processes Delta-R (dR) combination data (e.g., "RR", "RS", "SS"). It extracts the dR values from data[1] and appends them to the corresponding list in zp.deltaR.
zp
An instance of TopKinematics.
data
A tuple (name_string, list_of_floats) containing the data.

sect1.title: The TopKinematics Class
sect1.para: TopKinematics is a cdef class that inherits from SelectionTemplate. It is tailored for collecting and organizing kinematic information from top quarks and their combinations.

listitem.para:
__cinit__(self): The Cython "constructor" equivalent.
Initializes self.root_leaves to define specific ROOT branches (res_energy, spec_pt, mass_RR, dr_SS, etc.) and associates them with the appropriate helper functions (res_data, spec_data, mass_data, dr_data) for data processing during InterpretROOT.
Initializes several internal Python attributes (res_top_kinematics, spec_top_kinematics, mass_combi, deltaR) to None. These will be dynamically populated as data is processed by the helper functions.
Initializes a new C++ topkinematics object and assigns its pointer to self.ptr. It then upcasts self.ptr to a topkinematics* and assigns it to self.tt for specialized access.
__init__(self): (Not explicitly defined in the provided snippet) This would typically be the Python initializer.
__dealloc__(self): Deallocates the C++ topkinematics object pointed to by self.tt, ensuring proper memory management.

cdef void transform_dict_keys(self): (Not explicitly defined in the provided snippet) This method is inherited from SelectionTemplate and would be responsible for converting C++ data structures to Python dictionaries. Its absence here suggests that the data is directly populated into Python attributes by the helper functions.

sect1.title: C++ Interaction
sect1.para:
The TopKinematics class leverages Cython's capabilities for seamless C++ integration:
cdef class TopKinematics: Declares TopKinematics as a Cython extension type.
cdef topkinematics *tt: A C++ pointer to a topkinematics object, which is the specialized C++ backend for top quark kinematic analysis.
self.ptr = new topkinematics(): Initializes the base SelectionTemplate's C++ pointer.
self.tt = <topkinematics*>self.ptr: This line demonstrates C++ upcasting, allowing TopKinematics to fulfill the SelectionTemplate interface while internally managing its specific topkinematics data.
from AnalysisG.core.selection_template cimport SelectionTemplate: Imports the base SelectionTemplate class, from which TopKinematics inherits.
from AnalysisG.core.tools cimport as_dict: Imports utility functions for converting between C++ and Python data structures (though as_dict is not directly used in the provided snippet, it's imported).
